question: Which third-party indexers support Stellar, and which should I pick if I need historical cross-account filtering?

golden.answer: Historical cross-account filtering needs an indexer: RPC history is retention-bounded and Horizon has no arbitrary cross-account filters. As of 2026-11-14 the official Indexers overview lists SubQuery, OBSRVR, Goldsky (Turbo pipelines), OnFinality, Mercury, Alchemy's live Stellar Data API, and The Graph through Substreams only. Hubble/BigQuery fits deep historical SQL. Verify retention, data model and network coverage before committing.
keyFacts: Historical cross-account filtering needs an indexer; RPC history is bounded.
Names dated indexers from the official overview (e.g. SubQuery, OBSRVR, Goldsky, Alchemy).
The Graph supports Stellar through Substreams only, not Subgraphs or Token API.
avoid: Do NOT say Alchemy's Stellar Data API is still only planned; official docs call it live.
Do NOT claim The Graph has full Subgraph or Token API support for Stellar.
Do NOT recommend RPC alone for arbitrary historical cross-account filtering.
golden.notes: The roster changes; accept a later dated roster from the official overview. Goldsky serves Stellar through Turbo pipelines; naming Mirror is out of date.
